description:
Outcome: Repairer takes the next eligible visitor, from BRIEF.md.
Scope: Claim API/action, being-helped display and agreed access rules. Excludes: reassignment.
Acceptance: Ordering follows T-002; simultaneous repairers receive distinct visitors; retry after a lost successful response returns the original assignment without claiming another visitor.
Behaviour: Accessible empty, pending, conflict, error and recovery feedback.
Verification: API/UI integration and concurrent/lost-response tests using queue fixtures. Prerequisites: T-004; T-005 is not needed because fixtures supply entries. Assumptions: apply T-002 decisions.
title: Take the next visitor end to end
